# Immersion English

> A Sofia-based English language school offering speaking-focused online lessons for adults and an immersive summer programme in Dublin, Ireland for teenagers aged 13–17.

Immersion English was founded by Cathal (Lenny) Leonard and Lina Georgieva. Lenny is a native Irish English speaker, CELTA-qualified, with over 10 years of experience teaching General English and Business English — including at the British Council Sofia and international summer programmes in Oxford and Cambridge. Lina has a background in international education with the British Council.

The school operates under the tagline "English for Living" and focuses on real communication over passive study.

## Courses

- **Speak Up! Group English Course** — structured group speaking programme, 12 lessons over 6 weeks, max 8 students, online, B1 and above
- **Personal Speaking Coach** — 1:1 online coaching, flexible schedule, B1 and above, €45/lesson (bundle: 5 lessons €215, 10 lessons €405)
- **General English (1:1)** — individual lessons, €45/lesson (bundle: 5 lessons €215, 10 lessons €405)
- **Business English (1:1)** — tailored to professional goals, €45/lesson (bundle: 5 lessons €215, 10 lessons €405)
- **Exam Preparation** — IELTS and Cambridge CAE, 1:1 online, €45/lesson
- **Corporate Training** — tailored Business English programmes for companies in Sofia, 1:1 and small group sessions

## Dublin Summer 2027

An immersive 7-day English summer programme at University College Dublin (UCD) for Bulgarian teenagers aged 13–17.

- **Dates:** July 2027
- **Location:** University College Dublin (UCD), Dublin, Ireland
- **Price:** €1,350 per student (flights not included)
- **Deposit:** €350 (non-refundable); balance of €1,000 due 31 May 2027
- **Group size:** Maximum 13 students — all Bulgarian
- **Ages:** 13–17
- **Supervision:** Full supervision from arrival to departure; Bulgarian-speaking staff on hand at all times
- **Accommodation:** Single bedroom in a shared 4-bedroom apartment on UCD campus; 24/7 security
- **Trips included:** 6 half-day trips + 1 full-day excursion (Trinity College, Dublin Castle, Book of Kells, Howth Cliff Walk, St Stephen's Green, Glendalough)
- **Flights:** Not included; parents book direct Ryanair flights Sofia (SOF) → Dublin (DUB); step-by-step guide provided

## Key differentiators

- All-Bulgarian cohort (not a mixed international group)
- Direct programme ownership — not resold through an agency
- CELTA-qualified native teacher
- 1-week format (competitors typically require 2-week minimum)
- Small group cap of 13 students
- Pre-departure meeting in Sofia for parents and students
- British Council credentials of both founders
